page_title: NEW 1-2 LIV | Newcastle v Liverpool 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
90+6' One of the Liverpool players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Newcastle will take a free kick.
90+5' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Mohamed Salah laid the ball off to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+2' A player from Newcastle pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
89' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Alisson easily deals with the threat.
89' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
87' Sven Botman is substituted due to injury. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Matt Targett (Newcastle Utd).
86' The game is interrupted now, Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Yellow card! It's like Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. John Brooks agrees and books him.
84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
82' Substitution. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) will be replaced by Elliot Anderson.
81' 1 - 1 Goal! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.

79' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
77' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
77' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) replacing Joel Matip.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) coming on for Alexis Mac Allister.
77' Newcastle are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.

76' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the left post and ricochets away.
75' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
74' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sandro Tonali walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
72' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Anthony Gordon will be replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch for Alexander Isak.
71' The current number of corner kicks is 4:9.
69' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
69' Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

68' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
67' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd).
67' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Liverpool get a corner.

66' This free kick managed to threaten the opposition's goal. Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sent the ball towards the box, but failed to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
65' A clumsy foul by Diogo Jota (Liverpool) and John Brooks blows his whistle. Newcastle are awarded the free kick.

64' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
62' The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
62' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
61' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
60' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

60' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
58' Substitution. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) has come on for Cody Gakpo.
58' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) replaces Wataru Endo.
58' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
54' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Alisson stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
52' The possession of the ball – 58:42.
51' What was Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
50' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
48' The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
48' John Brooks blows his whistle. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play. Liverpool have a free kick.
47' Wonderful pass from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) for Alexander Isak, but they can't profit from it as Alisson comes off his line to collect.
47' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Newcastle.
45+3' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

45+2' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
45+2' John Brooks blows the whistle, Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul. Liverpool get a free kick.

45+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his effort goes high over the bar so it's going to be a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Liverpool win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
44' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd), but the defence gets it clear.
43' The foul by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was seen by John Brooks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

39' A rebound falls kindly for Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
37' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

36' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the top right corner. However, he couldn't beat Alisson, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.
36' Newcastle work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

36' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Luis Diaz walks off.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
32' A cross into the box from Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Newcastle, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' A VAR review has confirmed the red card for Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool).

28' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool), but referee John Brooks must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
28' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
25' 1 - 0 Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alisson with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:0.
24' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

24' Nick Pope makes a brilliant save! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!

21' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Newcastle, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
20' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
18' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

17' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot. His bullet is headed for the top left corner, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.

17' Great solo effort by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
16' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
15' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
14' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' The free kick from long range, taken by Newcastle, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Newcastle win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
9' The corner is swung in but Liverpool can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
8' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) gets a yellow card. The referee John Brooks made the right call.
4' A player from Newcastle takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) passes the ball onto Mohamed Salah, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
2' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
1' Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.

1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Liverpool have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Liverpool will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be John Brooks.
